meta.title: Model parameter editor
meta.description: Adds an edit button beside each model in the model list; clicking opens a flyout panel next to the list with context presets (128K/256K/512K/1M), a thinking toggle (default on, green=on), and reasoning levels (low/medium/high/xhigh/max, default high). Bailian-style endpoints are configured automatically; every config write is journaled and rolled back on uninstall.
